description: A Line worth 2 points or less gets no margin: half sung, its perfection is linePoints / lineMax; nothing sung, it gives no bonus; a Freestyle-only Line is no scored Line
comment: voiceValue = 2 + 8998 = 9000, so a hit Beat earns 1 point. Line 0: lineMax = 9000 × 2 / 9000 = 2, no margin. Line 1: lineMax = 8998, perfect at 8996. Line 2 has only a Freestyle note: no Line result, and scoredLineCount = 2, so each scored Line is worth 500.

players.comment: Line 0: 1 of its 2 Beats, linePoints 1, perfection 1 / 2 = 0.5 (with the margin it would be 1 / 0, clamped to 1), rating roundHalfUp(4) = 4, bonus 500 × 0.5 = 250. Line 1: all, perfection clamp(8998 / 8996) = 1, bonus 500. Notes 1 + 8998 = 8999, total 8999 + 750 = 9749.
Line 0 silent: linePoints 0, perfection 0, rating 0, no word, no bonus (USDX would give it its full share). Total 8998 + 500 = 9498.
